name: synccraft-blockdsl
description: Language grammar, semantic syntax highlighting, context-aware auto-completion (including v4.1 @layout/@component/@assembly/@stamps/gait/edge/banded/octagon constructs plus v3.2 mirror_x/radial/chain/macro symbols), hover documentation, snippets, document outline, go-to-definition, canonical formatting, and live SE(3) + 15-axis SAT + adaptive swept motion audit diagnostics for SyncCraft Block-DSL v4.1.

commands.title: Block-DSL: Run SE(3) + 15-Axis SAT & Swept Clip Audit

synccraft.blockdsl.pythonPath.description: Optional path to Python interpreter with `synccraft` installed. When empty, automatically checks `<workspace>/.venv/bin/python` then `python3`.

synccraft.blockdsl.enableCompilerAudit.description: Run SyncCraft's Python parser, SE(3) forward kinematics, and 15-axis SAT / P1-02 / sculpted audit on open and save when `synccraft` is available.

synccraft.blockdsl.auditBehaviorClipsOnS.description: Also audit 12-frame swept `@behavior` clips (`< 0.02u` stance slip & swept SAT) on save.
